directory.label: Select root directory
directory.help_text:
Select the directory to be watched.
Browsersync server will start with this directory as the root.
When files inside the selected directory are updated, the browser will reload.

extensions.label: File extensions to watch
extensions.help_text:
Select the file extensions to be watched.
When files with these extensions are updated, the browser will reload.

sync.label: Use Sync
sync.help_text:
Select the interactions to synchronize across browsers and devices.
Clicks, scrolling, form inputs, and page navigation will be reflected on all other connected devices.

proxy.label: Use Proxy
proxy.help_text: If you want to integrate with a local WordPress site or similar, enter its URL here.
